request: Warcraft 1 clone, 3D characters, running entirely in the browser. Phase 1 scope: a single simple skirmish mission only — one map, basic unit movement and combat. No full campaign, tech tree, resource economy depth, multiplayer, or AI opponent complexity beyond what a minimal skirmish needs.

issues.summary: clampPanTarget() clamped the look-at point to the raw map rectangle without insetting by the camera's ground-footprint half-extents, so panning revealed the void beyond the map edge. Fixed by insetting pan clamp by frustum footprint (43f1fd4). Inset math confirmed correct by resume QA.

Regression from 43f1fd4: camera distance band (default 60/MIN 20/MAX 100) made the ground footprint 3-5x the 48-map, so footprintInsets halfW (24.62 at MIN_DISTANCE=20, 16:9) exceeded map half 24 at EVERY zoom -> clampInset lo>hi fallback fired -> horizontal keyboard pan was a permanent no-op. Fixed (b872299) by recalibrating distances to MIN=10/DEFAULT=15/MAX=19: halfW now 12.31/18.46/23.39 at 16:9 (all <= map half 24; strict pan room at MIN/DEFAULT; MAX frames whole map). +2 regression tests assert inset < map half. Verified headlessly; 58/58 tests pass.
